summary: Backend regression suite passed all 4 scenarios. UI loaded and store creation was confirmed; the browser script stopped on a strict-mode locator ambiguity before completing later UI steps.
action_items: Complete a browser retest using a scoped store-row locator for connection, logout, and mobile checks.
Implement brute-force lockout after five failed logins if required by the auth playbook.
Make startup seed_admin update an existing admin password when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes.
Replace CORS wildcard with explicit configured origins when allow_credentials is enabled.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has no failed-login counter or lockout despite the requested auth verification checklist.
startup only inserts the admin and never reconciles an existing admin password.
CORS_ORIGINS is currently '*' while allow_credentials=True; credentialed browser CORS should use explicit origins.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST-prefixed store/client/product data and UI test stores for isolation checks; no seeded production records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health, admin cookie session/logout, dashboard/plans, store creation, client isolation, catalog, and unconfigured WAHA all passed via API. UI login/dashboard/store creation passed. Finish UI connection unavailable message, logout, mobile, and client login using scoped selectors.
rca of the issue: The interrupted UI runs were test harness issues: the first saw an old login notice before the async reload completed, the second omitted login in a fresh browser, and the final get_by_text matched both the store selector option and client-row text. No application failure was established from these interruptions.
